reviews.title: They ruined it
reviews.text: Weeks ago, I would have given this a 5-star review. I use it all the time in Japan for currency conversion, but also find uses for it every day for temperature and length conversions. I was extremely disappointed today to open the app and find it is not only full of advertisements and locked features, but the ads are pornographic. I will be deleting this immediately and am mortified I ever recommended it to friends and family if they are getting the same experience. So disappointing. I’ll find another app or just spend a few more seconds getting my conversions from Siri or Google.
